subject: Physics
question: A particle is projected with velocity v at an angle θ with the horizontal. At any instant, its velocity v' is at right angles to its initial direction of projection. The magnitude of v' is:
explanation: Horizontal component remains constant: v cosθ = v' sinθ ⇒ v' = v cotθ.

subject: Physics
question: A man standing on a road has to hold his umbrella at 30° with the vertical to keep the rain away. He throws the umbrella and starts running at 10 km/h. He finds that raindrops are hitting his head vertically. The speed of the raindrops with respect to the road is:
explanation: For rain to appear vertical, horizontal component of v_r must equal v_m. v_r sin 30° = 10 ⇒ v_r = 20 km/h.

subject: Physics
question: A projectile is fired from the surface of the earth with a velocity of 5 m/s and angle θ with the horizontal. Another projectile is fired from another planet with a velocity of 3 m/s at the same angle. It follows a trajectory identical to that of the projectile fired from the earth. The acceleration due to gravity on the planet is (Take g_earth = 9.8 m/s²):
explanation: For identical trajectories, u₁²/g₁ = u₂²/g₂. 25/9.8 = 9/g_p ⇒ g_p = 9.8 × 9 / 25 ≈ 3.5 m/s².

subject: Physics
question: A particle moves in a circle of radius 5 cm with constant speed and time period 0.2π s. The acceleration of the particle is:

subject: Physics
question: A boy can throw a stone up to a maximum height of 10 m. The maximum horizontal distance that the boy can throw the same stone up to will be:
explanation: Max height H = u²/2g = 10 ⇒ u²/g = 20. Max range R = u²/g = 20 m.

subject: Physics
question: The velocity of a projectile at the initial point A is (2î + 3ĵ) m/s. Its velocity (in m/s) at point B (at the same height) is:
explanation: Horizontal component remains unchanged (2î). Vertical component reverses direction at same height (-3ĵ). Result: 2î - 3ĵ.

subject: Physics
question: A ship A is moving westwards with a speed of 10 km/h and a ship B 100 km south of A is moving northwards with a speed of 10 km/h. The time after which the distance between them becomes shortest is:
explanation: Relative velocity of B w.r.t A is North-West. Shortest distance occurs when relative displacement is perpendicular to relative velocity. Time t = 100 / (10√2) × √2 = 5 h.

subject: Physics
question: If the time of flight of a projectile is doubled, for the same angle of projection, then the maximum height attained will be:
explanation: T = 2u sinθ/g and H = u² sin²θ/2g. H ∝ T². If T doubles, H becomes 4 times.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is moving such that its position coordinates (x,y) are (2m, 3m) at t=0, and (13m, 14m) at t=5 s. The average velocity vector from t=0 to t=5 s is:

subject: Physics
question: A car turns on a circular track of radius R with a constant speed v. The coefficient of friction between the road and the tires is μ. The maximum speed without skidding is:
explanation: Centripetal force is provided by friction: mv²/R = μmg ⇒ v = √(μRg).

subject: Physics
question: A body is projected at an angle θ with the horizontal. When it is at the highest point, its kinetic energy is 3/4 of its initial kinetic energy. The value of θ is:
explanation: At highest point, KE = ½m(u cosθ)² = KE₀ cos²θ. cos²θ = 3/4 ⇒ cosθ = √3/2 ⇒ θ = 30°.

subject: Physics
question: Two particles A and B are moving in uniform circular motion in concentric circles with the same time period of rotation. The ratio of angular speed of A to that of B is:
explanation: Angular speed ω = 2π/T. Since T is the same, ω_A : ω_B = 1 : 1.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is projected with kinetic energy K₀ at an angle of projection θ. At the highest point, its kinetic energy is K₀/2. The angle of projection is:
explanation: K_top = K₀ cos²θ = K₀/2 ⇒ cos²θ = 1/2 ⇒ θ = 45°.

subject: Physics
question: A river is flowing from west to east at a speed of 5 m/min. A man on the south bank of the river, capable of swimming at 10 m/min in still water, wants to swim across the river in the shortest time. He should swim in a direction:
options: Due north-east with double speed of river
At an angle of 60° with north
explanation: For shortest time, the man must maximize his velocity component perpendicular to the river flow. He should swim due north.

subject: Physics
question: The position vector of a particle R as a function of time is given by R = 4 sin(2πt)î + 4 cos(2πt)ĵ. Which one of the following statements is wrong?
options: Path is a circle of radius 4m
explanation: v = |dR/dt| = |8π cos(...)î - 8π sin(...)ĵ| = 8π m/s, not 8 m/s.

subject: Physics
question: A projectile is given an initial velocity of (î + 2ĵ) m/s. The Cartesian equation of its path is (Take g = 10 m/s²):
explanation: x = t, y = 2t - 5t². Substituting t=x, y = 2x - 5x².

subject: Physics
question: A particle of mass m is projected with velocity v making an angle of 45° with the horizontal. The magnitude of the change in its momentum when it lands on the level ground is:
explanation: Change in momentum Δp_y = m(v_fy - v_iy) = m(-v sin45° - v sin45°) = -2mv/√2 = -mv√2. Magnitude is mv√2.

subject: Physics
question: A stone is tied to a string of length l and is whirled in a vertical circle. At the lowest point, its speed is u. The magnitude of the change in velocity as it reaches the highest point is:
explanation: Speed at top v = √(u² - 4gl). Velocity vectors are opposite. Magnitude of vector difference |Δv| = √(u² + v²) = √(u² + u² - 4gl) = √(2(u² - 2gl)).

subject: Physics
question: For a particle in uniform circular motion, the acceleration a at a point P(R, θ) on the circle of radius R is (Here θ is measured from the x-axis):
explanation: Acceleration is centripetal (towards center). a = -(v²/R)(cosθ î + sinθ ĵ).

subject: Physics
question: A projectile can have the same range R for two angles of projection. If t₁ and t₂ be the time of flights in the two cases, then the product of the two time of flights is directly proportional to:
explanation: t₁ = 2u sinθ/g, t₂ = 2u cosθ/g. t₁ t₂ = 4u² sinθ cosθ/g² = 2R/g ∝ R.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is projected from the ground with an initial velocity of 20 m/s at an angle of 60° with the horizontal. The radius of curvature of its trajectory at the highest point is _____ m. (Take g = 10 m/s²)
explanation: At highest point, v = u cos60° = 10 m/s. a_n = g = 10 m/s². R = v²/a_n = 100/10 = 10 m.

subject: Physics
question: A boat which has a speed of 5 km/h in still water crosses a river of width 1 km along the shortest possible path in 15 minutes. The velocity of the river water in km/h is _____
explanation: Shortest path means resultant velocity is perpendicular to flow. v_boat² = v_river² + v_cross². v_cross = 1/(15/60) = 4 km/h. v_river = √(25 - 16) = 3 km/h.

subject: Physics
question: Two particles A and B are moving with uniform velocities. A is moving along x-axis with 10 m/s and B is moving along y-axis with 10 m/s. At t=0, A is at (0,0) and B is at (0, 100). The minimum distance between them is _____ m.
explanation: Relative velocity of B w.r.t A is (-10, 10). Initial relative position is (0, 100). Min distance = 100 sin 45° = 50√2 ≈ 70.71 m.

subject: Physics
question: A particle moves in a circle of radius 20 cm with a linear speed of 10 m/s. The angular velocity is _____ rad/s.

subject: Physics
question: A projectile is fired at an angle of 45° with the horizontal. Elevation angle of the projectile at its highest point as seen from the point of projection is _____ degrees. (Take tan⁻¹(0.5) = 26.56°)
explanation: tan α = H / (R/2) = (u² sin²θ/2g) / (u² sin2θ/2g) = tanθ / 2 = 1/2. α = arctan(0.5) ≈ 26.56°.

subject: Physics
question: The maximum range of a gun on horizontal terrain is 16 km. If g = 10 m/s², the muzzle velocity of the shell must be _____ m/s.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is moving in a circle of radius 2 m according to the relation θ = 3t² + 2t. The speed of the particle at t = 4 s is _____ m/s.
explanation: ω = dθ/dt = 6t + 2. At t=4, ω = 26 rad/s. v = rω = 2 × 26 = 52 m/s.

subject: Physics
question: A body is projected horizontally from the top of a tower with initial velocity 18 m/s. It hits the ground at angle 45°. The vertical component of velocity when it hits the ground is _____ m/s.
explanation: Angle is 45°, so tan 45° = v_y / v_x ⇒ v_y = v_x = 18 m/s.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is projected with velocity u at angle θ. At time t, its horizontal and vertical displacements are equal. The time t is u(sinθ - cosθ) / (k g). Find k.
explanation: x = y ⇒ u cosθ · t = u sinθ · t - ½gt² ⇒ t = 2u(sinθ - cosθ)/g. So k = 0.5.

subject: Physics
question: A cyclist is moving with a speed of 6 m/s. As he approaches a circular turn on the road of radius 120 m, he applies brakes and reduces his speed at a constant rate of 0.4 m/s². The magnitude of the net acceleration of the cyclist on the circular turn is _____ m/s².

subject: Physics
question: A particle of mass m is driven by a machine that delivers a constant power k watts. If the particle starts from rest, the force on the particle at time t is:
explanation: P = Fv = k. F = m(dv/dt). mv(dv/dt) = k ⇒ v = √(2kt/m). F = k/v = √(mk/2t).

subject: Physics
question: A body of mass m is accelerated uniformly from rest to a speed v in a time T. The instantaneous power delivered to the body as a function of time is:
explanation: a = v/T. v(t) = at = vt/T. P = Fv(t) = (ma)(vt/T) = m(v/T)(vt/T) = mv²t/T².

subject: Physics
question: A spring of force constant 800 N/m has an extension of 5 cm. The work done in extending it from 5 cm to 15 cm is:

subject: Physics
question: A force F = -K(yî + xĵ) acts on a particle moving in the xy-plane. Starting from the origin, the particle is taken along the positive x-axis to the point (a, 0) and then parallel to the y-axis to the point (a, a). The total work done by the force is:
explanation: Path 1: y=0, dy=0 ⇒ W₁ = 0. Path 2: x=a, dx=0 ⇒ W₂ = ∫₀ᵃ -Ka dy = -Ka². Total W = -Ka².

subject: Physics
question: A stone of mass m tied to a string of length l is whirled in a vertical circle. The ratio of its kinetic energy at the highest point to that at the lowest point is 1/5. The speed at the lowest point is:
explanation: v_top² = v_bot² - 4gl. KE_top/KE_bot = v_top²/v_bot² = 1/5 ⇒ 5(v_bot² - 4gl) = v_bot² ⇒ v_bot = √(5gl).

subject: Physics
question: A block of mass M is attached to the lower end of a vertical spring. The mass is released from rest with the spring initially unstretched. The maximum extension produced in the length of the spring will be:
explanation: By energy conservation: Loss in PE = Gain in Spring PE. Mgx = ½kx² ⇒ x = 2Mg/k.

subject: Physics
question: A particle of mass m is moving in a circular path of constant radius r such that centripetal acceleration is varying with time t as a_c = k²rt². The power delivered to the particle is:
explanation: v²/r = k²rt² ⇒ v = krt. a_t = dv/dt = kr. P = F_t v = (ma_t)v = m(kr)(krt) = mk²r²t.

subject: Physics
question: The potential energy of a 1 kg particle free to move along the x-axis is given by V(x) = (x⁴/4 - x²/2) J. The total mechanical energy is 2 J. The maximum speed (in m/s) is:
explanation: Min PE at x=±1, V_min = -0.25 J. Max KE = E - V_min = 2.25 J. ½mv² = 2.25 ⇒ v = √4.5 = 3/√2.

subject: Physics
question: A uniform chain of length L and mass M is lying on a smooth table and one-third of its length is hanging vertically down over the edge. The work required to pull the hanging part on to the table is:
explanation: Mass of hanging part = M/3. COM is at L/6 below table. W = (M/3)g(L/6) = MgL/18.

subject: Physics
question: A ball is dropped from a height h. If the coefficient of restitution is e, the height to which it rises after the n-th collision with the ground is:
explanation: Velocity after 1st collision v₁ = e√(2gh). Height h₁ = e²h. After n collisions, h_n = h e²ⁿ.

subject: Physics
question: Two identical balls A and B having velocities of 0.5 m/s and -0.3 m/s respectively collide elastically in one dimension. The velocities of B and A after the collision respectively will be:
explanation: For identical masses in 1D elastic collision, velocities are exchanged. v_A' = -0.3, v_B' = 0.5. Question asks B then A, so 0.5 m/s and -0.3 m/s.

subject: Physics
question: The bob of a pendulum of length l is pulled aside from its equilibrium position through an angle θ and then released. The bob will then pass through its equilibrium position with a speed v equal to:
explanation: Height raised h = l(1-cosθ). v = √(2gh) = √(2gl(1-cosθ)).

subject: Physics
question: A force F acting on an object varies with distance x as F = ax + bx². The work done in moving the object from x=0 to x=1 m is:
explanation: W = ∫₀¹ (ax + bx²)dx = [ax²/2 + bx³/3]₀¹ = a/2 + b/3.

subject: Physics
question: A particle of mass 0.1 kg is subjected to a force which varies with distance. The work done is the area under the F-x graph. If the graph is a rectangle from 0 to 4m with height 10N, the kinetic energy at x=4 m (starting from rest) is:
explanation: Work = Area under F-x graph. Area = 4 × 10 = 40 J. By Work-Energy theorem, ΔKE = 40 J.

subject: Physics
question: A body of mass m is accelerated uniformly from rest to a speed v in a time T. The instantaneous power delivered to the body as a function of time is:
explanation: P = Fv = (ma)(at) = m(v/T)(vt/T) = mv²t/T².

subject: Physics
question: A cord is used to lower vertically a block of mass M by a distance d with constant downward acceleration g/4. Work done by the cord on the block is:
explanation: Mg - T = M(g/4) ⇒ T = 3Mg/4. Work by tension = -T · d = -3Mgd/4.

subject: Physics
question: A particle moves from x=0 to x=5 m under the influence of a force F = 7 - 2x + 3x². The work done is:

subject: Physics
question: An engine pumps water continuously through a hose. Water leaves the hose with a velocity v and m is the mass per unit length of the water jet. What is the rate at which kinetic energy is imparted to water?
explanation: Mass flow rate dm/dt = mv. Power = d(KE)/dt = ½(dm/dt)v² = ½ mv³.

subject: Physics
question: A body of mass 1 kg begins to move under the action of a time dependent force F = (2t î + 3t² ĵ) N. What power will be developed by the force at time t?
explanation: a = F/m = 2t î + 3t² ĵ. v = ∫ a dt = t² î + t³ ĵ. P = F·v = 2t(t²) + 3t²(t³) = 2t³ + 3t⁵.

subject: Physics
question: A machine gun fires n bullets per second. Each bullet has a mass m and velocity v. The power of the gun is:
explanation: Energy per bullet = ½ mv². Bullets per second = n. Power = Energy/time = ½ nmv².

subject: Physics
question: A block of mass 2 kg is dropped from a height of 0.4 m on a spring of force constant k = 1960 N/m. The maximum distance the spring will be compressed is _____ cm. (Take g = 10 m/s²)
explanation: mg(h+x) = ½kx². 20(0.4+x) = 980x² ⇒ 980x² - 20x - 8 = 0. Solving gives x = 0.1 m = 10 cm.

subject: Physics
question: A particle of mass m is moving in a horizontal circle of radius r under a centripetal force equal to -K/r². The total energy of the particle is -K/(xr). Find x.
explanation: mv²/r = K/r² ⇒ KE = ½mv² = K/2r. PE = -∫ F dr = -K/r. Total E = KE + PE = -K/2r. So x = 2.

subject: Physics
question: A ball is dropped from a height of 20 m. It loses 50% of its energy on colliding with the ground. The height to which it rebounds is _____ m.
explanation: Energy after collision = 0.5 × mgh. mgh' = 0.5 mgh ⇒ h' = 10 m.

subject: Physics
question: A force F = (3î + 4ĵ) N acts on a particle and displaces it from (1, 2) to (3, 5). The work done is _____ J.

subject: Physics
question: The kinetic energy of a body is increased by 300%. The percentage change in its momentum is _____%.

subject: Physics
question: A machine gun fires 360 bullets per minute. Each bullet has a mass of 20 g and velocity 400 m/s. The power of the gun is _____ kW.
explanation: Bullets per sec = 6. P = n × ½mv² = 6 × 0.5 × 0.02 × 160000 = 9600 W = 9.6 kW.

subject: Physics
question: A body of mass 5 kg is thrown vertically up with a kinetic energy of 490 J. The height at which the kinetic energy becomes half of the original value is _____ m. (g=9.8 m/s²)
explanation: Loss in KE = Gain in PE. 490/2 = mgh ⇒ 245 = 5 × 9.8 × h ⇒ h = 245/49 = 5 m.

subject: Physics
question: A uniform rod of length 2 m and mass 4 kg is rotated about an axis passing through one end and perpendicular to its length. The work done to rotate it from rest to an angular velocity of 10 rad/s is _____ J.

subject: Physics
question: A spring of spring constant 5 × 10³ N/m is stretched initially by 5 cm from the unstretched position. The work required to stretch it further by another 5 cm is _____ J.

subject: Physics
question: A particle is acted upon by a force F = cx where c is a constant. The work done in displacing it from x=0 to x=x₁ is k cx₁². Find k.
explanation: W = ∫₀ˣ¹ cx dx = c[x²/2] = cx₁²/2. So k = 0.5.

subject: Physics
question: A thin uniform rod of length l and mass m is swinging freely about a horizontal axis passing through its end. Its maximum angular speed is ω. Its center of mass rises to a maximum height of:
explanation: ½Iω² = mgh. I = ml²/3. ½(ml²/3)ω² = mgh ⇒ h = l²ω²/6g.

subject: Physics
question: A solid sphere of mass M and radius R is rolling without slipping. The ratio of its translational kinetic energy to its rotational kinetic energy is:
explanation: KE_trans = ½Mv². KE_rot = ½Iω² = ½(2/5 MR²)(v/R)² = ⅕Mv². Ratio = (½)/(⅕) = 5/2.

subject: Physics
question: A circular disc of mass M is rotating about its axis with angular velocity ω₁. Another disc of same mass but half the radius is gently placed over it. The new angular velocity is:
explanation: I₁ω₁ = (I₁ + I₂)ω₂. I₁ = MR²/2, I₂ = M(R/2)²/2 = MR²/8. (MR²/2)ω₁ = (5MR²/8)ω₂ ⇒ ω₂ = 4ω₁/5.

subject: Physics
question: The moment of inertia of a uniform circular disc about a tangent in its own plane is:
explanation: I_diameter = MR²/4. By parallel axis theorem, I_tangent = MR²/4 + MR² = 5MR²/4.

subject: Physics
question: A torque of 10 N-m is applied on a wheel initially at rest. It rotates through 100 rad in 10 s. The moment of inertia of the wheel is _____ kg-m².

subject: Physics
question: A solid cylinder of mass M and radius R rolls down an inclined plane of height h. The angular velocity of the cylinder when it reaches the bottom is:
explanation: Mgh = ½Mv² + ½Iω² = ½M(Rω)² + ½(MR²/2)ω² = ¾MR²ω². ω = 1/R √(4gh/3).

subject: Physics
question: Two particles of masses m₁ and m₂ are separated by a distance r. The moment of inertia of the system about an axis passing through the center of mass and perpendicular to the line joining them is:
explanation: I = μr² where reduced mass μ = m₁m₂ / (m₁ + m₂).

subject: Physics
question: A ring of mass M and radius R is rotating about its axis with angular velocity ω. Two identical masses m are gently placed at the ends of a diameter. The new angular velocity is:
explanation: I₁ω = I₂ω'. MR²ω = (MR² + 2mR²)ω' ⇒ ω' = Mω/(M+2m).

subject: Physics
question: The angular momentum of a body is increased by 20%. The percentage increase in its kinetic energy is:
explanation: KE = L²/2I. KE ∝ L². If L' = 1.2L, KE' = (1.2)² KE = 1.44 KE. Increase = 44%.

subject: Physics
question: A disc is rolling without slipping on a horizontal surface. C is the center, P is the topmost point, Q is the bottommost point. The speeds of P, Q, C are v_P, v_Q, v_C. Then:
explanation: v_C = v, v_P = v + Rω = 2v, v_Q = v - Rω = 0. So v_P > v_C > v_Q.

subject: Physics
question: A thin horizontal circular disc is rotating about a vertical axis passing through its center. An insect is at rest at a point near the rim. The insect now moves along the diameter to the other end. During this journey, the angular speed of the disc:
explanation: As insect moves to center, I decreases, ω increases. As it moves away, I increases, ω decreases.

subject: Physics
question: A uniform square plate of side a and mass m has moment of inertia about an axis passing through its center and perpendicular to its plane as ma²/6. Its moment of inertia about one of its diagonals is:
explanation: By perpendicular axis theorem, I_z = I_x + I_y. By symmetry I_x = I_y (diagonals). 2I_diag = ma²/6 ⇒ I_diag = ma²/12.

subject: Physics
question: A solid sphere, a hollow sphere and a ring are released from top of an inclined plane (friction is sufficient for pure rolling). The one that reaches the bottom first is:
explanation: Acceleration a = g sinθ / (1 + k²/R²). Smallest k²/R² is for solid sphere (2/5). It has max acceleration.

subject: Physics
question: A particle performing uniform circular motion has angular momentum L. If its angular frequency is doubled and its kinetic energy halved, the new angular momentum is:
explanation: L = Iω, KE = ½Iω² = Lω/2. If ω' = 2ω, KE' = KE/2, then L'ω'/2 = (Lω/2)/2 ⇒ L'(2ω) = Lω/2 ⇒ L' = L/4.

subject: Physics
question: A mass m is moving with a constant velocity parallel to the x-axis. Its angular momentum with respect to the origin:
explanation: L = r × p. Since p is constant and perpendicular distance from origin is constant, L is constant.

subject: Physics
question: The ratio of radii of gyration of a circular disc and a circular ring of same radius about their axes is:
explanation: K_disc = R/√2, K_ring = R. Ratio = 1 : √2.

subject: Physics
question: A wheel having moment of inertia 2 kg-m² about its axis, rotates at 60 rpm. The torque required to stop it in one minute is:

subject: Physics
question: A solid cylinder of mass M and radius R has a light thread wound around it. The cylinder is allowed to fall under gravity. The tension in the thread is:
explanation: Mg - T = Ma. TR = Iα = (MR²/2)(a/R) ⇒ T = Ma/2. Mg - Ma/2 = Ma ⇒ a = 2g/3. T = Mg/3.

subject: Physics
question: A boy stands on a rotating table with his arms stretched. He suddenly folds his arms. His angular velocity:
explanation: By conservation of angular momentum, I decreases, so ω increases.

subject: Physics
question: The moment of inertia of a thin rod of mass M and length L about an axis passing through its center and making an angle θ with the rod is:
explanation: Perpendicular distance r = x sinθ. I = ∫(x sinθ)² dm = sin²θ ∫x² dm = (ML²/12)sin²θ.

subject: Physics
question: A disc of mass 2 kg and radius 0.5 m is rotating with angular velocity 10 rad/s. Its angular momentum is _____ kg-m²/s.

subject: Physics
question: A solid sphere of mass 5 kg and radius 0.2 m is rolling without slipping with velocity 2 m/s. Its total kinetic energy is _____ J.

subject: Physics
question: A wheel starts from rest and rotates with constant angular acceleration 2 rad/s². The angular displacement in 5 s is _____ rad.

subject: Physics
question: The moment of inertia of a uniform rod of mass 3 kg and length 2 m about an axis passing through one end and perpendicular to its length is _____ kg-m².

subject: Physics
question: A torque of 20 N-m produces an angular acceleration of 4 rad/s² in a body. Its moment of inertia is _____ kg-m².

subject: Physics
question: A ring of mass 2 kg and radius 0.5 m is rotating about its axis with angular velocity 10 rad/s. Its rotational kinetic energy is _____ J.

subject: Physics
question: A solid cylinder of mass 10 kg and radius 0.2 m rolls down an incline of height 5 m. Its velocity at the bottom is _____ m/s. (Take g=10 m/s², answer to 2 decimal places)

subject: Physics
question: Two masses 1 kg and 2 kg are placed at the ends of a massless rod of length 3 m. The distance of the center of mass from the 1 kg mass is _____ m.

subject: Physics
question: A flywheel rotates at 600 rpm. Its angular velocity is _____ rad/s. (Take π = 3.14)

subject: Physics
question: A body of mass 2 kg is moving in a circle of radius 0.5 m with a speed of 4 m/s. The centripetal force acting on it is _____ N.
